brief_text: ten dominoes stand in a row; the first is tipped over and knocks down the rest, and every domino ends tilted at least 15 degrees from upright

usage.text:
Ten dominoes (2 × 5 × 10 cm boxes, about 0.1 kg each) stand 6 cm apart along +x. The keyframe gives `domino1` a forward spin of 4 rad/s, which is more than enough to tip it past its balance point. Each domino then topples into the next. `domino10` falls flat on the floor, and the rest come to rest leaning heavily on their neighbours, well past 15°.

    <body name="domino1" pos="0 0 0.05">

The expectations below only check that each domino hits the next one and that the last reaches the floor. None of them can express the brief's 15° final tilt, so passing them doesn't confirm that part.

```expect
domino1 touches domino2
domino2 touches domino3
domino3 touches domino4
domino4 touches domino5
domino5 touches domino6
domino6 touches domino7
domino7 touches domino8
domino8 touches domino9
domino9 touches domino10
domino10 touches floor
```

verdict.what_happens: domino1 is spun forward by the keyframe and hits domino2 at 0.12 s; each domino then topples into the next in sequence, the last contact (domino9 on domino10) at 1.10 s. By 1.5 s all are at rest: dominoes 1-9 lean on each other at 71-72 degrees from upright and domino10 lies flat on the floor at 90 degrees, unchanged through 6 s.

usage.text:
The scene does what the brief asks. The keyframe spin tips domino1 into domino2 at 0.12 s. The fall then runs down the row in order, each domino first hitting the next about 0.1 s after the one before, reaching domino10 at 1.10 s. By 1.5 s everything is at rest. Dominoes 1–9 lie leaning on their neighbours at 71–72° from upright, and domino10 lies flat at 90°. All of them are far beyond the 15° the brief requires, and they stay that way through 6 s.
